messages:
Ava (Eng PM): Quick sync — running a short milestone check for the upcoming compliance window. Need clarity on three items: 1) auditlog backfill ETA, 2) HSM attestation slot confirmations, 3) KMS rotation docs for auditors. Please ping owners.

Mateo (Security): Auditlog backfill: we're at 73% of backfill complete. ETA depends on final schema mapping from eng. Expect finish by EOD Tue if no schema bugs.

Jin (Infra): HSM attestation slots — vendor gave us two windows next week (Wed 09:00 and Fri 14:00 PT). Which one should we reserve? We need ops + sec on call.

Priya (Serv): Schema mapping question — I flagged 2 fields in the ingest mapping PR that change retention tags. Those need security signoff before we backfill. @Mateo @Lukas can you review? PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ingest/pulls/542

Lukas (SecEng): On it. I'll review the mapping tonight. If it's only retention tags we can approve with a note for auditors. If it touches auth metadata we need small changes.

Carla (QA): Backfill smoke test checklist ready. Two quick tests: 1) random sample event parity, 2) retention TTL verification. I can run them once PR merges.

Ava (Eng PM): Perfect. For the attestation slot, let's tentatively take Wed 09:00 PT — Jin, can you reserve and add runbook? We need deploy freeze window noted.

Jin (Infra): Reserving Wed 09:00 PT now. Added calendar invite and push to runbook: 
```
- Attestation runbook: /playbooks/hsm-attest.md
- Pre-checks: keystore sync complete, auditlog backfill < 100% blocked_by_schema
- Post: evidence upload to compliance-bucket
```

SRE-Deploy-Bot: Deploy freeze window registered for 2025-03-12 08:30-11:30 PT. Notifying oncall.

Tom (Product): Heads up — if backfill overlaps customer metrics queries we may want to throttle. Ops, pls coordinate with support.

Priya (Serv): Noted. We can add @support a temporary throttling flag. Carla, will tests need a dev snapshot or prod slice?

Carla (QA): Prod slice with synthetic markers is best. I'll coordinate with Priya for the slice id.

Mateo (Security): KMS rotation docs: auditors asked for rotation steps + rollback procedure. Lukas, can you assemble the step-by-step and the HSM proof artifacts? I can annotate with control refs.

Lukas (SecEng): I'll draft a doc today: includes key rotation commands, auditor checklist, and signed attestations. Expect link by EOD. Also need to capture KMS IAM bindings diff — @Jin can you export the last 7 days of IAM changes for the package?

Jin (Infra): Yup, exporting now. Will drop artifact at gs://redwood-compliance/iam-diffs/1758009999-7d.json

Ava (Eng PM): Action items recap: 
- Priya: merge mapping PR after Lukas signoff
- Carla: run smoke tests on backfill slice post-merge
- Jin: reserve Wed slot + IAM export + runbook update
- Lukas: KMS rotation doc + HSM artifacts
- Mateo: annotate docs with control refs for auditors
- Tom: coordinate customer-facing throttling communication if needed
Please reply with own ✅ or blockers.

Priya (Serv): ✅ will wait for Lukas, then merge and trigger backfill.

Lukas (SecEng): ✅ drafting now. If I find auth metadata change I'll comment inline.

Carla (QA): ✅ prepping test harness and slice ID.

Jin (Infra): ✅ calendar + artifacts uploaded.

Mateo (Security): Blocker: auditors requested proof of multi-region key storage for one control. Need confirmation that we have KMS replicas in eu-west1. @Jin can you confirm?

Jin (Infra): Confirmed — KMS key is replicated to eu-west1. I uploaded replication manifest to the same bucket: gs://redwood-compliance/kms/replication-manifest-1758009999.json

Tom (Product): Throttling plan: notify top 5 impacted customers 24h before, include a dashboard link. I'll draft the note and share.

Ava (Eng PM): Great — last ask: please add any artifacts to the compliance folder with filename prefix 1758009999- so auditors can find them. I'll follow up in the audit tracker.

SRE-Deploy-Bot: Compliance artifacts checklist reminder: auditlog, kms-manifest, iam-diff, attestation-doc. 0/4 items marked complete.

Mateo (Security): I'll mark items as we get them. Thanks everyone — will re-open thread if anything slips. :thumbsup:
